app_info.subtitle: Spaced-repetition flashcards
app_info.description: What Beats Learning is a remote MCP tutor for spaced-repetition flashcards. Sign in with Google to get an isolated FSRS library, then ask ChatGPT to create atomic cue-answer notes, attach pronunciation audio or study images, and run reviews. It does not access other users' libraries, send email, post publicly, or move money.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns the signed-in Google identity and this user's library counts without creating or changing cards.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only this user's private library. It does not post, message, or change any public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or otherwise change stored data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new note and FSRS card(s) in the signed-in user's library.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes only to this user's private library. It does not publish content or change public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds a new note. It does not delete or overwrite existing cards.

justifications.read_only_justification: Atomically creates up to 50 notes in the signed-in user's library.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes only to this user's private library.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds new notes. It does not delete or overwrite existing cards.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates or reuses a cached pronunciation clip in private object storage and returns a hash.
justifications.open_world_justification: Stores audio in this service's private cache. It does not publish the clip or post it elsewhere.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds or reuses a cached clip. It does not overwrite an existing hash's bytes.

justifications.read_only_justification: Attaches a previously generated audio hash to one stored note field.
justifications.open_world_justification: Updates only this user's private note. It does not publish audio.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds an audio attachment. It does not delete the note or the clip.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates or reuses a cached study image. With replace=true it overwrites the cached image for that subject.
justifications.open_world_justification: Stores the image in this service's private cache. It does not publish the image.
justifications.destructive_justification: replace=true overwrites the cached image for a subject. The default path only adds a cache entry.

justifications.read_only_justification: Fetches an image URL the user supplied and stores the bytes in a private content-addressed cache.
justifications.open_world_justification: Downloads the requested image into private storage. It does not post, publish, or change the source site.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds a cached object keyed by content hash. It does not overwrite other hashes.

justifications.read_only_justification: Attaches a previously generated or imported image hash to one stored note field.
justifications.open_world_justification: Updates only this user's private note. It does not publish the image.
justifications.destructive_justification: replace=true swaps an existing field image. The default path only adds an attachment.

justifications.read_only_justification: Adds a delayed reverse FSRS card to existing notes that do not already have one.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes only to this user's private library.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds a reverse direction. Already-reversed notes are skipped; nothing is deleted.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns the next due review card, or empty if nothing is due. It does not grade or reschedule.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only this user's private library.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not change stored cards or schedules.

justifications.read_only_justification: Records an FSRS rating and reschedules that card.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes only to this user's private schedule.
justifications.destructive_justification: Updates scheduling state for one card. It does not delete the card or other notes.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns this user's teaching-style prompt without changing it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only this user's private pedagogy settings.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify the stored prompt.

justifications.read_only_justification: Merges feedback, replaces, or resets this user's teaching-style prompt.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes only to this user's private pedagogy settings.
justifications.destructive_justification: reset=true or full_prompt replaces the stored teaching prompt.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists this user's decks and counts without changing them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only this user's private library.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify decks or cards.

justifications.read_only_justification: Peeks at cards currently eligible to be served without grading them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only this user's private library.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify schedules or card content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists this user's cards, cues, and media hashes without changing them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only this user's private library.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify cards or media.

test_cases.description: Identify the signed-in learner and skip quizzing an empty library.
test_cases.user_prompt: Start a What Beats Learning session. Who am I, and do I have any cards yet?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the Google name/email and library counts. If empty_library is true, the assistant asks what to learn instead of quizzing.

test_cases.description: Create one atomic flashcard in a named deck.
test_cases.user_prompt: Add a Mandarin travel card: front 谢谢, back thank you, extra polite thanks, reverse both directions.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates one note in a travel deck with a delayed reverse and returns the new card id(s).

test_cases.description: Serve and grade the next due review.
test_cases.user_prompt: Quiz me on my next due card, then mark it good if I recall it.
test_cases.expected_output: Shows the cue, waits for recall, then grades the specific card_id. If empty is true, it does not invent a quiz.

test_cases.user_prompt: What decks do I have, and what is due to review right now?
test_cases.expected_output: Lists deck totals plus the currently servable queue, excluding future reviews and delayed reverses.

test_cases.description: Inventory cards in a deck without reviewing them.
test_cases.user_prompt: List the cards in my Mandarin travel deck with their ids.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns card ids, cues, schedule state, and media hashes for that deck.

negative_test_cases.description: Refuse to read another person's library.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the flashcards for google_id 12345, not my account.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The assistant should not attempt to select another user's database. Tools are scoped to the signed-in Google account only.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not send study content out of the library.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Email my entire card library to a friend and post today's quiz on Twitter.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The plugin cannot send email or publish to social networks. It should refuse and offer to list or review cards in-chat instead.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not treat the tutor as a payments or banking app.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send $50 from my bank account and pay this invoice.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The plugin should not be used for payments, transfers, or financial transactions.
